messages:
Alex Chen: FYI — AcmeCorp POC kickoff tomorrow. Need quick alignment on hosting, security asks, and success metrics. Can we do a 15m sync in #presales after standup?
Maria Gomez: yes, ping me after standup. what are their hard constraints?
Alex Chen: they listed: EU data residency, SOC2 + encryption at rest, ability to bring own KMS, and an SLA for <150ms p50 for short-chat flows. Also they want cost estimate for 100k tokens/day.
Jamal Carter: EU residency pushes either Hosted in eu-west-1 or Dedicated in our EU pool. Private (on-prem) is possible but adds 2–3 week setup and extra legal review.
Priya Nair: quick note on SLA — Hosted can offer soft SLOs for POC; Dedicated can be SLA-backed once we commit reserved capacity. Private needs SRE handoff.
Maria Gomez: for acceptance criteria we should ask for 3 things: 1) quality: eval prompts + pass rate >= 90% on their prompt set, 2) perf: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms for 256-token generation, 3) cost: cost-per-1k-tokens under their threshold.
Alex Chen: agreed. I already requested their prompt set and 10 evals. They responded with a CSV of 120 prompts.
Jamal Carter: for perf numbers we need target qps estimate. Ask them for concurrent users. If 10 concurrent requests sustained with 256 tokens, Dedicated with 4x A10G (or 2x A100) should handle it comfortably with batching.
Priya Nair: security Q: do they require full audit logs and VPC peering? If yes, Hosted private plane or Dedicated inside customer VPC required. Also they want BYOK — we support KMS wraps for Dedicated and Private.
Maria Gomez: on pricing — rough hosted estimate: at 100k tokens/day ~ 3M tokens/month — send them ballpark $X. For Dedicated, we'll need to price reserved capacity + incremental token usage. Jamal can you draft a committed capacity option?
Jamal Carter: will draft. Quick calc: 3M tokens/mo ~ if avg 0.5 tokens/usd unit (placeholder) — but i'll put real rates after matching model and quantization. Also note quantized variants drop token compute ~30–50%.
Alex Chen: timeline constraints from customer: 2 week POC, then a 6-week pilot if performance checks out. They want deployment option recommendation by EOD.
Priya Nair: 2-week POC where we run hosted in eu-west + canary to a small Dedicated pool is realistic. Private/on-prem is out for 2 weeks.
Maria Gomez: propose success plan: week 0 — ingest prompt set + baseline eval, infra: hosted eu-west with prefix cache enabled; week 1 — perf tuning, batching, quantization test; week 2 — final eval and SLA readouts. Deliverable: pass/fail per acceptance criteria + cost delta.
Alex Chen: can we include a small sample eval snippet in the POC to measure quality? e.g.:
```
Input: "Summarize the following customer support ticket in 2 sentences: [TICKET TEXT]"
Expected: contains customer issue, requested action, and sentiment tag
```
Use exact scoring rubric (precision/recall) for entities.
Jamal Carter: noted. I'll set up a perf harness and a Prometheus scrape for token latency and qps. Also will enable request-level traces for first 48h.
Maria Gomez: security questionnaire items to confirm: SOC2 status yes, data deletion policy, KMS BYOK flow, VPC peering steps, and legal DPA. Alex — please attach their security form when you drop the CSV.
Alex Chen: attaching now (uploaded to sales drive). One last blocker: legal asked if Dedicated reserved capacity requires 3-month minimum. SalesBot: Reserved capacity terms: standard is 3-month minimum for Dedicated; enterprise custom terms negotiable.
Priya Nair: ok callout — region fallback: recommend primary eu-west-1, fallback to eu-central-1 for capacity bursts. Make sure we include cross-region data flow notes in SOW.
Maria Gomez: i'll draft an email to Acme summarizing hosting recommendation (Start Hosted eu-west during POC, optional Dedicated canary after week 1 if perf needed). Will include acceptance criteria, timeline, and pricing ask.
Alex Chen: thanks — can everyone react with :thumbsup: if aligned?
Jamal Carter: :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: :thumbsup:
SalesBot: Reminder: presales intake updated — add final doc to CRM ticket ACME-243 before EOD.
